summary: Mechanical Engineering undergraduate at the University of Minho with a strong interest in the intersection of engineering, technology, and artificial intelligence. Advanced in CAD modeling with SolidWorks and Solid Edge, comfortable with Python at an intermediate level for analysis and simulation, and experienced in using AI tools to accelerate software development. This range has been applied to real prototypes, including a 1st-place competition vehicle, and to personal software projects built end-to-end.

highlights: Admitted in the 2024/2025 academic year as a 1st-choice applicant, with an entrance average of 17.6 (rounded to 18).

Development of Formula Water, a vehicle prototype powered by water's potential energy.
Study of system dynamics, motion transmission, friction, stability, and center of mass.
Use of Python for simulations and results analysis, and SolidWorks/Solid Edge for modeling mechanical components.
